d: Watch an engaging and insightful conversation with Kiran Rao on ‘Select Conversations with Tisca Chopra’. In this candid episode, Kiran Rao opens up about her journey as a filmmaker, discovering her creative voice, storytelling with purpose, and the making of ‘Laapataa Ladies’. From cinema and theatre to acting, editing, and the evolving audience culture, this conversation offers a deeper look into the mind behind some of India’s most memorable stories.
